description: Execute a SQL query against a registered data source using DuckDB. Returns up to --max-rows rows (default 1000). In read-only mode (default), only SELECT statements are allowed. Use source='_all' to query across all CSV sources with cross-source joins. Supports limit and offset for pagination.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (pagination)

max_rows.description: Override the default max row limit for this query

offset.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results (pagination)

source.description: Name of the source to query, or '_all' for cross-source joins. Required if multiple sources are registered.

sources.description: Array of source names for cross-source queries (alternative to source='_all')

name: query
